<section id="A2" class="ltx_appendix">
<h2 class="ltx_title ltx_title_appendix"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_appendix">Appendix B </span>TabPFN Use Case Overview</h2>

<div id="A2.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A2.p1.1" class="ltx_p">TabPFNv2 has been applied to a broad set of use cases. We now list 100 published use cases across different industries.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section id="Ax1" class="ltx_appendix">
<h2 class="ltx_title ltx_title_appendix">Healthcare and Life Sciences</h2>

<div id="Ax1.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.p1.1" class="ltx_p">We collected 51 published TabPFN use cases in this area, by far more than in any other area; we attribute this partly to the scarcity of data in healthcare and life sciences, and partly to the open publishing culture in this area. Use cases span oncology, neurology, cardiology, psychiatry, nephrology, and pharmacology. Applications include diagnosis, prognosis, and treatment response prediction from multimodal clinical, imaging, and omics data, often under severe data scarcity.</p>
</div>
<div id="Ax1.p2" class="ltx_para">
<ol id="Ax1.I1" class="ltx_enumerate">
<li id="Ax1.I1.i1" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">1.</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.i1.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.i1.p1.1" class="ltx_p">TabPFN was applied to distinguish cancer patients from healthy individuals using immune system profiles from peripheral blood, facilitating predictions of immunotherapy responses <cite class="ltx_cite ltx_citemacro_cite">[<a href="#bib.bib40" title="" class="ltx_ref">32</a>]</cite>. <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/how-bostongene-utilized-tabpfn-identify-immune-system-profiles-vexle/" title="" class="ltx_ref ltx_href">Link</a></p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.i2" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">2.</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.i2.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.i2.p1.1" class="ltx_p">A machine learning model employing TabPFN was developed for non-invasive diagnostic prediction of minimal change disease in patients with nephrotic syndrome, utilizing clinical biomarkers <cite class="ltx_cite ltx_citemacro_cite">[<a href="#bib.bib41" title="" class="ltx_ref">33</a>]</cite>. <a href="https://www.nature.com/articles/s41598-024-73898-4" title="" class="ltx_ref ltx_href">Link</a></p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.i3" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">3.</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.i3.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.i3.p1.1" class="ltx_p">TabPFN was integrated into a system for analyzing T-cell receptor repertoires combined with clinical biomarkers to forecast immunotherapy outcomes in cancer patients, as explored by researchers at BostonGene <cite class="ltx_cite ltx_citemacro_cite">[<a href="#bib.bib42" title="" class="ltx_ref">34</a>]</cite>. <a href="https://www.cell.com/cancer-cell/fulltext/S1535-6108(24)00132-6" title="" class="ltx_ref ltx_href">Link</a></p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.i4" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">4.</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.i4.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.i4.p1.1" class="ltx_p">TabPFN enabled early detection of stillbirth risks through analysis of cardiotocography data, supporting improved prenatal care <cite class="ltx_cite ltx_citemacro_cite">[<a href="#bib.bib43" title="" class="ltx_ref">35</a>]</cite>. <a href="https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S2472630324000852" title="" class="ltx_ref ltx_href">Link</a></p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.i5" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">5.</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.i5.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.i5.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Predictive modeling for postoperative outcomes following anterior cervical corpectomy utilized TabPFN to assess patient demographics and surgical parameters <cite class="ltx_cite ltx_citemacro_cite">[<a href="#bib.bib44" title="" class="ltx_ref">36</a>]</cite>. <a href="https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11366553/" title="" class="ltx_ref ltx_href">Link</a></p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.i6" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">6.</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.i6.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.i6.p1.1" class="ltx_p">A hybrid model incorporating TabPFN was introduced to predict dementia progression in Parkinson’s disease patients, handling small datasets and missing values effectively <cite class="ltx_cite ltx_citemacro_cite">[<a href="#bib.bib45" title="" class="ltx_ref">37</a>]</cite>. <a href="https://journals.sagepub.com/doi/full/10.1177/20552076241272585" title="" class="ltx_ref ltx_href">Link</a></p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.i7" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">7.</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.i7.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.i7.p1.1" class="ltx_p">A machine learning model based on TabPFN was developed to predict 90-day unfavorable outcomes in stroke patients with distal vessel occlusions using CT perfusion imaging <cite class="ltx_cite ltx_citemacro_cite">[<a href="#bib.bib46" title="" class="ltx_ref">38</a>]</cite>. <a href="https://www.ajnr.org/content/early/2024/10/28/ajnr.A8547.abstract" title="" class="ltx_ref ltx_href">Link</a></p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.i8" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">8.</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.i8.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.i8.p1.1" class="ltx_p">TabPFN was utilized in chemoproteomics for identifying small-molecule fragment-protein interactions, aiding ligand discovery in drug development <cite class="ltx_cite ltx_citemacro_cite">[<a href="#bib.bib47" title="" class="ltx_ref">39</a>]</cite>. <a href="https://www.science.org/doi/abs/10.1126/science.adk5864" title="" class="ltx_ref ltx_href">Link</a></p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.i9" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">9.</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.i9.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.i9.p1.1" class="ltx_p">TabPFN facilitated the prediction of non-invasive ventilation outcomes in patients with acute hypoxemic respiratory failure, supporting early identification of treatment failures <cite class="ltx_cite ltx_citemacro_cite">[<a href="#bib.bib48" title="" class="ltx_ref">40</a>]</cite>. <a href="https://www.researchgate.net/profile/Antonio-Esquinas/publication/393595503_Early-prediction-of-non-invasive_ventilation_outcome_using_the_TabPFN_machine_learning_model_a_multi-centre_validation_study/links/68718bc56e247f362b18c4b8/Early-prediction-of-non-invasive-ventilation-outcome-using-the-TabPFN-machine-learning-model-a-multi-centre-validation-study.pdf" title="" class="ltx_ref ltx_href">Link</a></p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.i10" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">10.</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.i10.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.i10.p1.1" class="ltx_p">An interpretable Transformer-based model leveraging TabPFN was created to predict intravenous immunoglobulin resistance in pediatric patients with Kawasaki disease <cite class="ltx_cite ltx_citemacro_cite">[<a href="#bib.bib49" title="" class="ltx_ref">41</a>]</cite>. <a href="https://journals.plos.org/plosone/article?id=10.1371/journal.pone.0327564" title="" class="ltx_ref ltx_href">Link</a></p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.i11" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">11.</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.i11.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.i11.p1.1" class="ltx_p">TabPFN was employed in visual representation techniques for prostate cancer diagnosis, converting clinical biomarkers and symptom data into formats suitable for analysis <cite class="ltx_cite ltx_citemacro_cite">[<a href="#bib.bib50" title="" class="ltx_ref">42</a>]</cite>. <a href="https://www.mdpi.com/2306-5354/11/7/635" title="" class="ltx_ref ltx_href">Link</a></p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.i12" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">12.</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.i12.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.i12.p1.1" class="ltx_p">TabPFN was used to combine clinical, MR morphological, and delta-radiomics features to predict lymphovascular invasion in invasive breast cancer patients <cite class="ltx_cite ltx_citemacro_cite">[<a href="#bib.bib51" title="" class="ltx_ref">43</a>]</cite>. <a href="https://journals.sagepub.com/doi/full/10.1177/15330338251362050" title="" class="ltx_ref ltx_href">Link</a></p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.i13" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">13.</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.i13.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.i13.p1.1" class="ltx_p">TabPFN is proposed to predict mental health trajectories through digital phenotyping, enabling proactive and personalized interventions in precision psychiatry <cite class="ltx_cite ltx_citemacro_cite">[<a href="#bib.bib52" title="" class="ltx_ref">44</a>]</cite>. <a href="https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/epdf/10.1002/mdr2.70017" title="" class="ltx_ref ltx_href">Link</a></p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.i14" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">14.</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.i14.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.i14.p1.1" class="ltx_p">TabPFN contributed to cardiovascular disease risk stratification using clinical features from a large patient cohort, incorporating interpretability techniques <cite class="ltx_cite ltx_citemacro_cite">[<a href="#bib.bib53" title="" class="ltx_ref">45</a>]</cite>. <a href="https://github.com/Bruno-LSo/ML-Health-TABPFN" title="" class="ltx_ref ltx_href">Link</a></p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.i15" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">15.</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.i15.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.i15.p1.1" class="ltx_p">TabPFN outperformed traditional machine learning models for early prediction of acute kidney injury in hospitalized patients, demonstrating generalizability across datasets <cite class="ltx_cite ltx_citemacro_cite">[<a href="#bib.bib54" title="" class="ltx_ref">46</a>]</cite>. <a href="https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=5397006" title="" class="ltx_ref ltx_href">Link</a></p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.i16" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">16.</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.i16.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.i16.p1.1" class="ltx_p">TabPFN was integrated into a framework for predicting postoperative mobility and discharge destinations in older adults using sensor data <cite class="ltx_cite ltx_citemacro_cite">[<a href="#bib.bib55" title="" class="ltx_ref">47</a>]</cite>. <a href="https://www.mdpi.com/1424-8220/25/16/5021" title="" class="ltx_ref ltx_href">Link</a></p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.i17" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">17.</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.i17.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.i17.p1.1" class="ltx_p">TabPFN supported the prediction of infant temperament from maternal mental health data, aiding early identification of at-risk infants <cite class="ltx_cite ltx_citemacro_cite">[<a href="#bib.bib56" title="" class="ltx_ref">48</a>]</cite>. <a href="https://www.frontiersin.org/journals/public-health/articles/10.3389/fpubh.2025.1659987/abstract" title="" class="ltx_ref ltx_href">Link</a></p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.i18" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">18.</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.i18.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.i18.p1.1" class="ltx_p">TabPFN was employed to characterize clinical risk profiles for complications in type 2 diabetes mellitus patients, focusing on neuropathy and retinopathy <cite class="ltx_cite ltx_citemacro_cite">[<a href="#bib.bib57" title="" class="ltx_ref">49</a>]</cite>. <a href="https://www.frontiersin.org/journals/endocrinology/articles/10.3389/fendo.2025.1657366/abstract" title="" class="ltx_ref ltx_href">Link</a></p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.i19" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">19.</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.i19.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.i19.p1.1" class="ltx_p">TabPFN was extended with a longitudinal-to-cross-sectional transformation to forecast Alzheimer’s disease progression on neuroimaging datasets <cite class="ltx_cite ltx_citemacro_cite">[<a href="#bib.bib58" title="" class="ltx_ref">50</a>]</cite>. <a href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.17649" title="" class="ltx_ref ltx_href">Link</a></p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.i20" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">20.</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.i20.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.i20.p1.1" class="ltx_p">TabPFN supported uncertainty calibration evaluation in medical data using variational techniques <cite class="ltx_cite ltx_citemacro_cite">[<a href="#bib.bib59" title="" class="ltx_ref">51</a>]</cite>. <a href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.10048" title="" class="ltx_ref ltx_href">Link</a></p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.i21" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">21.</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.i21.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.i21.p1.1" class="ltx_p">TabPFN was applied to predict tumor response to chemotherapy in cholangiocarcinoma patients using RNA expression landscapes <cite class="ltx_cite ltx_citemacro_cite">[<a href="#bib.bib60" title="" class="ltx_ref">52</a>]</cite>. <a href="https://aacrjournals.org/clincancerres/article/31/13_Supplement/A020/763312" title="" class="ltx_ref ltx_href">Link</a></p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.i22" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">22.</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.i22.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.i22.p1.1" class="ltx_p">TabPFN was incorporated into a generative model framework for tasks like data augmentation and imputation in biomedicine <cite class="ltx_cite ltx_citemacro_cite">[<a href="#bib.bib61" title="" class="ltx_ref">53</a>]</cite>. <a href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.05216" title="" class="ltx_ref ltx_href">Link</a></p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.i23" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">23.</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.i23.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.i23.p1.1" class="ltx_p">TabPFN facilitated the prediction of gallstone malignancy risks through analysis of associated disease factors <cite class="ltx_cite ltx_citemacro_cite">[<a href="#bib.bib62" title="" class="ltx_ref">54</a>]</cite>. <a href="https://www.mdpi.com/2077-0383/14/17/6091" title="" class="ltx_ref ltx_href">Link</a></p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.i24" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">24.</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.i24.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.i24.p1.1" class="ltx_p">TabPFN was used in classifying tuberculosis treatment outcomes based on clinical and sociodemographic data from national registries <cite class="ltx_cite ltx_citemacro_cite">[<a href="#bib.bib63" title="" class="ltx_ref">55</a>]</cite>. <a href="https://www.researchsquare.com/article/rs-7502054/v1" title="" class="ltx_ref ltx_href">Link</a></p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.i25" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">25.</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.i25.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.i25.p1.1" class="ltx_p">TabPFN contributed to early prediction of gestational diabetes using cell-free DNA and genetic scores from early pregnancy blood samples <cite class="ltx_cite ltx_citemacro_cite">[<a href="#bib.bib64" title="" class="ltx_ref">56</a>]</cite>. <a href="https://www.medrxiv.org/content/10.1101/2025.09.03.25334985v1" title="" class="ltx_ref ltx_href">Link</a></p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.i26" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">26.</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.i26.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.i26.p1.1" class="ltx_p">TabPFN was used for predicting schizophrenia based on sense of agency features, emphasizing interpretability <cite class="ltx_cite ltx_citemacro_cite">[<a href="#bib.bib65" title="" class="ltx_ref">57</a>]</cite>. <a href="https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/abs/pii/S187620182500317X" title="" class="ltx_ref ltx_href">Link</a></p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.i27" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">27.</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.i27.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.i27.p1.1" class="ltx_p">TabPFN was integrated into a physiologically based pharmacokinetic model for predicting dissolution and absorption of amorphous solid dispersions in drug development <cite class="ltx_cite ltx_citemacro_cite">[<a href="#bib.bib66" title="" class="ltx_ref">58</a>]</cite>. <a href="https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jconrel.2025.114123" title="" class="ltx_ref ltx_href">Link</a></p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax1.I1.i28" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">28.</span> 
<div id="Ax1.I1.i28.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax1.I1.i28.p1.1" class="ltx_p">TabPFN enabled classification of respiratory diseases from sound data, addressing clinical spectrum diversity <cite class="ltx_cite ltx_citemacro_cite">[<a href="#bib.bib67" title="" class="ltx_ref">59</a>]</cite>. <a href="https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=5529540" title="" class="ltx_ref ltx_href">Link</a></p>

<section id="Ax2" class="ltx_appendix">
<h2 class="ltx_title ltx_title_appendix">Financial Services, Banking, and Insurance</h2>

<div id="Ax2.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax2.p1.1" class="ltx_p">While we have seen strong customer interest in this area, this is not reflected by the relatively few published use cases (only 3) we managed to collect; we attribute this to the domain’s competitive nature and disinclination to publish.</p>
</div>
<div id="Ax2.p2" class="ltx_para">
<ol id="Ax2.I2" class="ltx_enumerate">
<li id="Ax2.I2.i1" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">1.</span> 
<div id="Ax2.I2.i1.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax2.I2.i1.p1.1" class="ltx_p">TabPFN was applied to usage-based premium calculations in actuarial science, leveraging driving behavior data from IoT devices <cite class="ltx_cite ltx_citemacro_cite">[<a href="#bib.bib89" title="" class="ltx_ref">83</a>]</cite>. <a href="https://idp.springer.com/authorize/casa?redirect_uri=https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s13385-024-00388-2&amp;casa_token=5LdKiRIXfwEAAAAA:45MEDhjSq66DEqh96gk0NTWrhozhvBbd73mH-oMMuukD0EeHxH1fx3DTtp7h_l04IAjDuJXnpO2uHaHxjw" title="" class="ltx_ref ltx_href">Link</a></p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax2.I2.i2" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">2.</span> 
<div id="Ax2.I2.i2.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax2.I2.i2.p1.1" class="ltx_p">TabPFN facilitated cross-selling of health insurance products through deep learning analysis of customer data <cite class="ltx_cite ltx_citemacro_cite">[<a href="#bib.bib90" title="" class="ltx_ref">84</a>]</cite>. <a href="https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/abstract/document/10475046" title="" class="ltx_ref ltx_href">Link</a></p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax2.I2.i3" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">3.</span> 
<div id="Ax2.I2.i3.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax2.I2.i3.p1.1" class="ltx_p">TabPFN was used in corporate bond recovery rate prediction for credit risk management <cite class="ltx_cite ltx_citemacro_cite">[<a href="#bib.bib91" title="" class="ltx_ref">85</a>]</cite>. <a href="https://github.com/hoanguyen94/Recovery-rate-prediction" title="" class="ltx_ref ltx_href">Link</a></p>

<section id="Ax3" class="ltx_appendix">
<h2 class="ltx_title ltx_title_appendix">Energy and Utilities</h2>

<div id="Ax3.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax3.p1.1" class="ltx_p">We collected 15 use cases focused on environmental forecasting (algal blooms, wildfire, rainfall), renewable<span id="Ax3.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text">-</span>energy nowcasting, process/asset optimization across water, oil &amp; gas, and materials.</p>
</div>
<div id="Ax3.p2" class="ltx_para">
<ol id="Ax3.I3" class="ltx_enumerate">
<li id="Ax3.I3.i1" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">1.</span> 
<div id="Ax3.I3.i1.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax3.I3.i1.p1.1" class="ltx_p">TabPFN was employed to predict river algal blooms through multi-classification of chlorophyll-a concentrations, aiding water management <cite class="ltx_cite ltx_citemacro_cite">[<a href="#bib.bib92" title="" class="ltx_ref">86</a>]</cite>. <a href="https://koreascience.kr/article/JAKO202427157640711.page" title="" class="ltx_ref ltx_href">Link</a></p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax3.I3.i2" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">2.</span> 
<div id="Ax3.I3.i2.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax3.I3.i2.p1.1" class="ltx_p">TabPFN facilitated wildfire propagation prediction in Canadian conifer forests, classifying fire types for environmental risk assessment <cite class="ltx_cite ltx_citemacro_cite">[<a href="#bib.bib93" title="" class="ltx_ref">87</a>]</cite>. <a href="https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S157495412400253X" title="" class="ltx_ref ltx_href">Link</a></p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax3.I3.i3" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">3.</span> 
<div id="Ax3.I3.i3.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax3.I3.i3.p1.1" class="ltx_p">TabPFN was integrated into a machine learning framework for optimizing energy consumption at wastewater treatment plants <cite class="ltx_cite ltx_citemacro_cite">[<a href="#bib.bib94" title="" class="ltx_ref">88</a>]</cite>. <a href="https://www.researchgate.net/publication/390516459_Machine_learning_framework_for_energy_consumption_optimization_using_the_TabPFNRegressor_algorithm" title="" class="ltx_ref ltx_href">Link</a></p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax3.I3.i4" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">4.</span> 
<div id="Ax3.I3.i4.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax3.I3.i4.p1.1" class="ltx_p">TabPFN supported rainfall forecast post-processing using historical error patterns from environmental data <cite class="ltx_cite ltx_citemacro_cite">[<a href="#bib.bib95" title="" class="ltx_ref">89</a>]</cite>. <a href="https://github.com/aarxshi/rainfall_tabpfn" title="" class="ltx_ref ltx_href">Link</a></p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax3.I3.i5" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">5.</span> 
<div id="Ax3.I3.i5.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax3.I3.i5.p1.1" class="ltx_p">TabPFN enabled solar forecast error adjustment, particularly during rapid weather changes, as developed by Open Climate Fix <cite class="ltx_cite ltx_citemacro_cite">[<a href="#bib.bib96" title="" class="ltx_ref">90</a>]</cite>. <a href="https://gist.github.com/anshulg954/5f4423ee6b3d3151fa8d0d7fcd98d3eb" title="" class="ltx_ref ltx_href">Link</a></p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax3.I3.i6" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">6.</span> 
<div id="Ax3.I3.i6.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax3.I3.i6.p1.1" class="ltx_p">TabPFN was applied to predict ash fusibility in high-alkali coal for improved energy production <cite class="ltx_cite ltx_citemacro_cite">[<a href="#bib.bib97" title="" class="ltx_ref">91</a>]</cite>. <a href="https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=5406504" title="" class="ltx_ref ltx_href">Link</a></p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax3.I3.i7" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">7.</span> 
<div id="Ax3.I3.i7.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax3.I3.i7.p1.1" class="ltx_p">TabPFN contributed to predicting Henry coefficients for alkanes in zeolites, aiding hydroisomerization in sustainable fuel production <cite class="ltx_cite ltx_citemacro_cite">[<a href="#bib.bib98" title="" class="ltx_ref">92</a>]</cite>. <a href="https://pubs.acs.org/doi/full/10.1021/acs.jpcc.5c03868" title="" class="ltx_ref ltx_href">Link</a></p>

<li id="Ax3.I3.i8" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">8.</span> 
<div id="Ax3.I3.i8.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax3.I3.i8.p1.1" class="ltx_p">TabPFN facilitated shape-selectivity modeling in zeolites for long-chain alkane hydroisomerization, optimizing catalyst design <cite class="ltx_cite ltx_citemacro_cite">[<a href="#bib.bib99" title="" class="ltx_ref">93</a>]</cite>. <a href="https://doi.org/10.4233/uuid:f36da034-5cb3-42ca-a53d-d351f68a9ffa" title="" class="ltx_ref ltx_href">Link</a></p>

<p id="Ax3.I3.i9.p1.1" class="ltx_p">TabPFN was used in an integrated framework for estimated ultimate recovery prediction and fracturing optimization in shale gas reservoirs <cite class="ltx_cite ltx_citemacro_cite">[<a href="#bib.bib100" title="" class="ltx_ref">94</a>]</cite>. <a href="https://www.researchgate.net/publication/395761327_Coupling_EUR_Prediction_with_Fracturing_Optimization_An_Integrated_Machine_Learning_Framework_for_Shale_Gas_Development" title="" class="ltx_ref ltx_href">Link</a></p>

<p id="Ax3.I3.i10.p1.1" class="ltx_p">TabPFN supported core data augmentation for enhanced reservoir parameter prediction in oil and gas exploration <cite class="ltx_cite ltx_citemacro_cite">[<a href="#bib.bib101" title="" class="ltx_ref">95</a>]</cite>. <a href="https://www.researchgate.net/publication/395434405_Enhancing_Reservoir_Parameter_Prediction_Workflows_via_Advanced_Core_Data_Augmentation" title="" class="ltx_ref ltx_href">Link</a></p>

<p id="Ax3.I3.i12.p1.1" class="ltx_p">TabPFN contributed to physics-informed regression for evaluating solar-reflective materials in facade temperature modeling <cite class="ltx_cite ltx_citemacro_cite">[<a href="#bib.bib103" title="" class="ltx_ref">97</a>]</cite>. <a href="https://arxiv.org/pdf/2507.16174" title="" class="ltx_ref ltx_href">Link</a></p>

<p id="Ax3.I3.i13.p1.1" class="ltx_p">TabPFN was applied to generate advanced global heat flow maps at 0.2° resolution, integrating high-resolution geophysical data to improve geothermal resource modeling <cite class="ltx_cite ltx_citemacro_cite">[<a href="#bib.bib104" title="" class="ltx_ref">98</a>]</cite>. <a href="https://www.researchgate.net/publication/396728153_The_First_02_Resolution_Global_Continental_Heat_Flow_Map_Advancing_Fine-Scale_Geothermal_Modeling" title="" class="ltx_ref ltx_href">Link</a></p>

<p id="Ax3.I3.i14.p1.1" class="ltx_p">TabPFN contributed to FuelCast, standardizing benchmarks for ship fuel consumption prediction and improving efficiency in maritime operations <cite class="ltx_cite ltx_citemacro_cite">[<a href="#bib.bib105" title="" class="ltx_ref">99</a>]</cite>. <a href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.08217" title="" class="ltx_ref ltx_href">Link</a></p>

<p id="Ax3.I3.i15.p1.1" class="ltx_p">TabPFN was used as the main supervised classifier to automatically identify thunderstorm ground enhancements from particle detector and environmental measurements <cite class="ltx_cite ltx_citemacro_cite">[<a href="#bib.bib138" title="" class="ltx_ref">100</a>]</cite>. <a href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.25125" title="" class="ltx_ref ltx_href">Link</a></p>

<section id="Ax4" class="ltx_appendix">
<h2 class="ltx_title ltx_title_appendix">Manufacturing and Industrial</h2>

<div id="Ax4.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax4.p1.1" class="ltx_p">We collected 12 diverse use cases including anomaly detection, predictive maintenance, physics<span id="Ax4.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text">-</span>aware optimization—spanning IIoT security, rotating machinery, semiconductor testing, geotechnical/optical sensing, machining, battery thermal modeling, and concrete mix design.</p>
</div>

<div id="Ax4.I4.i1.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax4.I4.i1.p1.1" class="ltx_p">TabPFN enabled early fault classification in rotating machinery, addressing data scarcity in industrial scenarios <cite class="ltx_cite ltx_citemacro_cite">[<a href="#bib.bib106" title="" class="ltx_ref">101</a>]</cite>. <a href="https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/abstract/document/10318062" title="" class="ltx_ref ltx_href">Link</a></p>

<p id="Ax4.I4.i2.p1.1" class="ltx_p">TabPFN facilitated microcontroller performance prediction, aiding semiconductor screening with minimal supervision, as studied at Infineon Technologies <cite class="ltx_cite ltx_citemacro_cite">[<a href="#bib.bib107" title="" class="ltx_ref">102</a>]</cite>. <a href="https://iris.polito.it/handle/11583/3002056" title="" class="ltx_ref ltx_href">Link</a></p>

<div id="Ax5.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax5.p1.1" class="ltx_p">We collected 19 further heterogeneous TabPFN applications spanning geoscience, forensic science, agriculture, materials, and engineering domains—ranging from microbiome classification and lunar regolith analysis to soil property modeling, crop yield and phenology forecasting, fuel-blend optimization, and spatial regression.</p>

<p id="Ax5.I5.i14.p1.1" class="ltx_p">TabPFN informed the development of TabImpute, enabling efficient zero-shot imputation for missing tabular data and improving preprocessing pipelines <cite class="ltx_cite ltx_citemacro_cite">[<a href="#bib.bib131" title="" class="ltx_ref">126</a>]</cite>. <a href="https://www.arxiv.org/abs/2510.02625" title="" class="ltx_ref ltx_href">Link</a></p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax5.I5.i15" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">15.</span> 
<div id="Ax5.I5.i15.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax5.I5.i15.p1.1" class="ltx_p">TabPFN, alongside TabICL and related foundation models, was evaluated for intrusion detection, improving cybersecurity performance in IoT networks <cite class="ltx_cite ltx_citemacro_cite">[<a href="#bib.bib132" title="" class="ltx_ref">127</a>]</cite>. <a href="https://www.mdpi.com/2079-9292/14/19/3792" title="" class="ltx_ref ltx_href">Link</a></p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax5.I5.i16" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">16.</span> 
<div id="Ax5.I5.i16.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax5.I5.i16.p1.1" class="ltx_p">TabPFN supported continual learning for tabular data streams in resource-constrained environments <cite class="ltx_cite ltx_citemacro_cite">[<a href="#bib.bib133" title="" class="ltx_ref">128</a>]</cite>. <a href="https://arxiv.org/html/2510.04660v1" title="" class="ltx_ref ltx_href">Link</a></p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax5.I5.i17" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">17.</span> 
<div id="Ax5.I5.i17.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax5.I5.i17.p1.1" class="ltx_p">TabPFN contributed to assessing robustness of language models for data fitting under irrelevant variations <cite class="ltx_cite ltx_citemacro_cite">[<a href="#bib.bib134" title="" class="ltx_ref">129</a>]</cite>. <a href="https://arxiv.org/pdf/2508.19563" title="" class="ltx_ref ltx_href">Link</a></p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax5.I5.i18" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">18.</span> 
<div id="Ax5.I5.i18.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax5.I5.i18.p1.1" class="ltx_p">TabPFN was used in forensic science to advance biogeographical ancestry predictions <cite class="ltx_cite ltx_citemacro_cite">[<a href="#bib.bib1" title="" class="ltx_ref">130</a>]</cite>. <a href="https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S1872497325000705" title="" class="ltx_ref ltx_href">Link</a></p>
</div></li>
<li id="Ax5.I5.i19" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">19.</span> 
<div id="Ax5.I5.i19.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="Ax5.I5.i19.p1.1" class="ltx_p">TabPFN was used as a benchmark model for predicting avocado alternate bearing from Sentinel-2 and climate features <cite class="ltx_cite ltx_citemacro_cite">[<a href="#bib.bib136" title="" class="ltx_ref">131</a>]</cite>. <a href="https://www.preprints.org/manuscript/202510.2413" title="" class="ltx_ref ltx_href">Link</a></p>
</div></li>
</ol>
</div>
</section>
<section id="A3" class="ltx_appendix">
<h2 class="ltx_title ltx_title_appendix"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_appendix">Appendix C </span>Data Contamination and Deduplication for Real-TabPFN-2.5</h2>

<div id="A3.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A3.p1.1" class="ltx_p">To ensure fair evaluation and eliminate data contamination, we implemented an enhanced multi-tiered deduplication and filtering pipeline for Real-TabPFN-2.5. While based on the methodology used for Real-TabPFN <cite class="ltx_cite ltx_citemacro_cite">[<a href="#bib.bib29" title="" class="ltx_ref">18</a>]</cite>, the process was extended to deduplicate the training datasets against all internal benchmarks, our curated in-house validation suite, and the public TabArena benchmark <cite class="ltx_cite ltx_citemacro_cite">[<a href="#bib.bib32" title="" class="ltx_ref">1</a>]</cite>. Our deduplication procedure combines automated cross-referencing of dataset identifiers, feature schemas, and row- and column-level hashes with manual metadata inspection to ensure that no training dataset overlaps with, or is derived from, any evaluation dataset. Datasets failing these criteria were excluded from the final training corpus.</p>
</div>
<section id="A3.SS1" class="ltx_subsection">

<section id="A4" class="ltx_appendix">
<h2 class="ltx_title ltx_title_appendix"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_appendix">Appendix D </span>Details on Causal Inference Results</h2>

<section id="A4.SS0.SSS0.Px1" class="ltx_paragraph">
<h4 class="ltx_title ltx_title_paragraph">Causal Inference</h4>

<div id="A4.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A4.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Most real-world decision problems ultimately hinge on causal questions—understanding what would happen if we intervened, rather than merely observing correlations. Estimating Conditional Average Treatment Effects (CATEs) is one of the central ways to answer these “what-if” questions: how would an individual’s outcome change if a treatment were applied versus withheld?</p>
</div>
</section>
<section id="A4.SS0.SSS0.Px2" class="ltx_paragraph">
<h4 class="ltx_title ltx_title_paragraph">Unconfounded Settings.</h4>

<div id="A4.SS0.SSS0.Px2.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A4.SS0.SSS0.Px2.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Many causal inference methods require <span id="A4.SS0.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">unconfoundedness</span>, which broadly states that there are no features not included in the dataset that influence both the <span id="A4.SS0.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_italic">treatment</span> variable and the outcome <cite class="ltx_cite ltx_citemacro_cite">[<a href="#bib.bib6" title="" class="ltx_ref">132</a>]</cite>. While recent studies have begun to challenge the validity and verifiability of this assumption <cite class="ltx_cite ltx_citemacro_cite">[<a href="#bib.bib17" title="" class="ltx_ref">133</a>, <a href="#bib.bib19" title="" class="ltx_ref">15</a>]</cite>, there are presently a wide variety of causal inference methods designed for the unconfounded setting <cite class="ltx_cite ltx_citemacro_cite">[<a href="#bib.bib18" title="" class="ltx_ref">134</a>, <a href="#bib.bib20" title="" class="ltx_ref">135</a>]</cite>.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section id="A4.SS0.SSS0.Px3" class="ltx_paragraph">
<h4 class="ltx_title ltx_title_paragraph">Importance of Base Model.</h4>

<div id="A4.SS0.SSS0.Px3.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A4.SS0.SSS0.Px3.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Recent empirical findings have shown that when unconfoundedness holds, CATE estimation can be framed as an AutoML problem <cite class="ltx_cite ltx_citemacro_cite">[<a href="#bib.bib16" title="" class="ltx_ref">136</a>]</cite>, as many CATE estimators require a choice of classification or regression model to approximate the likelihood (propensity) of a treatment and an outcome given an individual’s features. Parallel studies <cite class="ltx_cite ltx_citemacro_cite">[<a href="#bib.bib15" title="" class="ltx_ref">137</a>, <a href="#bib.bib19" title="" class="ltx_ref">15</a>]</cite> have shown that TabPFN is an especially strong choice for meta-learners such as the X-, T-, and S-Learner <cite class="ltx_cite ltx_citemacro_cite">[<a href="#bib.bib14" title="" class="ltx_ref">138</a>]</cite>, hypothesizing that its strong performance in tabular prediction transfers to the problem of causal inference.</p>
</div>
<figure id="A4.T3" class="ltx_table">
<figcaption class="ltx_caption ltx_centering"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_table"><span id="A4.T3.3" class="ltx_text" style="font-size:90%;">Table 3</span>: </span><span id="A4.T3.4" class="ltx_text" style="font-size:90%;">Description of causal inference datasets in the RealCause benchmark.</span></figcaption>
<table id="A4.T3.5" class="ltx_tabular ltx_centering ltx_guessed_headers ltx_align_middle">

<section id="A6" class="ltx_appendix">
<h2 class="ltx_title ltx_title_appendix"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_appendix">Appendix F </span>Additional Internal Benchmark Details</h2>

<section id="A6.SS1" class="ltx_subsection">
<h3 class="ltx_title ltx_title_subsection"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_subsection">F.1 </span>Details on the normalization</h3>

<div id="A6.SS1.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A6.SS1.p1.1" class="ltx_p">For benchmarking, we normalize scores per dataset to enable averaging and clearer comparison across datasets, ensuring that differences in dataset difficulty do not bias comparisons. For each dataset, we linearly scale scores between 0 (worse model on this dataset) and 1 (best model). For each model, the default and tuned versions are considered as two different models for the normalization. Bar heights show the mean normalized performance, and error bars denote the standard error of the mean (SEM) across datasets, reflecting uncertainty from dataset variability.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section id="A6.SS2" class="ltx_subsection">
<h3 class="ltx_title ltx_title_subsection"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_subsection">F.2 </span>Additional results on many features</h3>

</div>

<section id="A8" class="ltx_appendix">
<h2 class="ltx_title ltx_title_appendix"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_appendix">Appendix H </span>Results with Tuned Decision Thresholds</h2>

<div id="A8.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A8.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Starting with TabPFN-2.5, our framework supports tuning the decision threshold to optimize for specific metrics. Figure <a href="#A8.F17" title="Figure 17 ‣ Appendix H Results with Tuned Decision Thresholds" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">17</span></a> quantifies the performance gains that this procedure can yield, illustrating substantial improvement in F1-score for several imbalanced datasets when tuning the threshold.</p>
</div>
<figure id="A8.F17" class="ltx_figure"><object type="image/svg+xml" data="2511.08667v1/tuned_F1_delta.svg" id="A8.F17.g1" class="ltx_graphics ltx_centering ltx_img_landscape" style="aspect-ratio:336/240;" width="336" height="240"></object>
<figcaption class="ltx_caption ltx_centering"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_figure"><span id="A8.F17.4" class="ltx_text" style="font-size:90%;">Figure 17</span>: </span><span id="A8.F17.5" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold" style="font-size:90%;">F1-score sometimes improves substantially by decision threshold tuning.<span id="A8.F17.5.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_medium"> The plot shows the difference in F1-score (macro) between a model with an optimized decision threshold and the same model using a default (untuned) threshold. This demonstrates the effectiveness of the tuning procedure for metric-specific optimization.</span></span></figcaption>
</figure>
</section>
<section id="A9" class="ltx_appendix">
<h2 class="ltx_title ltx_title_appendix"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_appendix">Appendix I </span>Supplementary Inference Time Details</h2>

<div id="A9.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A9.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Figure <a href="#A9.F18" title="Figure 18 ‣ Appendix I Supplementary Inference Time Details" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">18</span></a> shows the inference latency you can expect for three common models of GPUs.
Figure <a href="#A9.F19" title="Figure 19 ‣ Appendix I Supplementary Inference Time Details" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">19</span></a> shows that the time scales linearly with the number of test rows.
Figure <a href="#A9.F20" title="Figure 20 ‣ Appendix I Supplementary Inference Time Details" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">20</span></a> compares the fit + training time of TabPFN-2.5 vs TabPFNv2, showing that TabPFN-2.5 is significantly faster, showing between 1x and 2.3x speedup depending on the dataset size.</p>
</div>
<figure id="A9.F18" class="ltx_figure"><object type="image/svg+xml" data="2511.08667v1/latency_line_plot.svg" id="A9.F18.g1" class="ltx_graphics ltx_centering ltx_img_square" style="width:35.629em; height:40.616em;aspect-ratio:473/540;" width="473" height="540"></object>
<figcaption class="ltx_caption ltx_centering"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_figure"><span id="A9.F18.3" class="ltx_text" style="font-size:90%;">Figure 18</span>: </span><span id="A9.F18.4" class="ltx_text" style="font-size:90%;">
Time taken, in seconds, to train TabPFN-2.5 models on various training set sizes, and then make predictions on <math id="A9.F18.m8" class="ltx_Math" alttext="500" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>500</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">500</annotation></semantics></math> test rows, using three common models of NVIDIA GPU: T4 15GB, A100 SXM 40GB, H100 SXM 80GB.
Performance is shown for <math id="A9.F18.m9" class="ltx_Math" alttext="100" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>100</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">100</annotation></semantics></math>, <math id="A9.F18.m10" class="ltx_Math" alttext="300" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>300</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">300</annotation></semantics></math>, and <math id="A9.F18.m11" class="ltx_Math" alttext="500" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>500</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">500</annotation></semantics></math> features.
Datasets with more than <math id="A9.F18.m12" class="ltx_Math" alttext="500" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>500</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">500</annotation></semantics></math> features have the same performance as datasets with <math id="A9.F18.m13" class="ltx_Math" alttext="500" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>500</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">500</annotation></semantics></math>, as each estimator will subsample to <math id="A9.F18.m14" class="ltx_Math" alttext="500" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>500</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">500</annotation></semantics></math> features.
Incomplete lines indicate that the GPU had insufficient memory for that dataset size.
</span></figcaption>
</figure>
<figure id="A9.F19" class="ltx_figure"><object type="image/svg+xml" data="2511.08667v1/latency_test_set_scaling.svg" id="A9.F19.g1" class="ltx_graphics ltx_centering ltx_img_landscape" style="width:17.562em; height:11.060em;aspect-ratio:233/147;" width="233" height="147"></object>
<figcaption class="ltx_caption ltx_centering"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_figure"><span id="A9.F19.3" class="ltx_text" style="font-size:90%;">Figure 19</span>: </span><span id="A9.F19.4" class="ltx_text" style="font-size:90%;">
The time taken by TabPFN-2.5 to train and predict scales linearly in the test set size, shown here for a classification model trained on datasets of <math id="A9.F19.m5" class="ltx_Math" alttext="500" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>500</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">500</annotation></semantics></math> rows <math id="A9.F19.m6" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\times" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mo>×</mo><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\times</annotation></semantics></math> 10 features, 5,000 rows <math id="A9.F19.m7" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\times" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mo>×</mo><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\times</annotation></semantics></math> 100 features, and 20,000 rows <math id="A9.F19.m8" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\times" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mo>×</mo><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\times</annotation></semantics></math> 500 features.
Measured on one H100 GPU.
</span></figcaption>
</figure>
<figure id="A9.F20" class="ltx_figure"><object type="image/svg+xml" data="2511.08667v1/v2_vs_v25_time.svg" id="A9.F20.g1" class="ltx_graphics ltx_centering ltx_img_landscape" style="aspect-ratio:613/230;" width="613" height="230"></object>
<figcaption class="ltx_caption ltx_centering"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_figure"><span id="A9.F20.4" class="ltx_text" style="font-size:90%;">Figure 20</span>: </span><span id="A9.F20.5" class="ltx_text" style="font-size:90%;">
<span id="A9.F20.5.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">TabPFN-2.5 is significantly faster than TabPFNv2</span>. Comparison of the time taken to fit + predict TabPFN-2.5 vs TabPFNv2 on different number of rows and features. Measured for 100 test points on 1 H100, using the same number of estimators (8). Note that this is measured using the v2 and v2.5 versions available on the latest release of the TabPFN package, and thus is on top of the performance improvements since the original release of TabPFNv2.
</span></figcaption>
</figure>
</section>
</article>
